card.name: Opening parenthesis after a result value
card.fires_on: The opening parenthesis right after a reported trial number such as a percentage, msec change, or median. It is followed by a spread, count, range, or interval such as ±SD, n/N, or range.

modes.label: Count or n after a percentage
modes.description: Parenthesis after a percentage that opens a fraction or n value.

modes.label: Spread after a mean or median
modes.description: Parenthesis after a mean, median, or change value that opens a range, SD, or confidence interval.

card.writes: It favors words like ranging and ranges, and disfavors mean, which fits a parenthesis that opens a range.
card.plain: It marks the bracket after a study result where the range, spread, or patient count is about to be given.
